limitations: The live journey runs real production server functions with local database persistence and live providers. It does not test browser interaction or HTTP authentication routes.

developmentFindings: A fixed verb filter missed natural and multilingual report requests; removed it and retained source-grounded classification.
An audit-specific posture and account override disable the earlier station/patrol cover. Evidence-specific and admission-specific fallback replies preserve established facts.
Legacy jeep-admission evaluation expectations were corrected when the audit has already been presented.

The complete live run exposed host discovery being blocked by guarded-state assumptions and long grouped transcripts; the current question and independently checked trigger now recover eligible ordinary reports. Call→jeep and jeep→medical prerequisites are enforced in code.
Initial account quotation handling now tolerates terminal punctuation changes but not added or paraphrased words.
A generic Kabir response blocked substantive coverage; authored public introductory answers now recover rejected basic responses.
